'''P'arghat''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who served under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mordon (Human)|Mordon]] on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance II|''Vengeance'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Stele Chronicles" />
